remarks: Rare single-story retreat in a prime Morrison Highlands location. Set on approximately one-third of an acre, this 3,833-square-foot, 4-bedroom, 4-bath residence offers an exceptional combination of privacy, picturesque mountain views and beautiful sunrises. Soaring ceilings and abundant natural light enhance the spacious living areas, creating an inviting setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The private backyard embraces the Southern California lifestyle with a pool and spa, mature landscaping and multiple areas to relax and entertain, all framed by the surrounding mountain scenery.
